grades: subjects, not findings: a subject is a defect if any adjudicated run graded a finding on it CORRECT
why: A gate decides whether to spend the check leg on a subject. What it must not skip is a subject with a real defect, whichever LLM run happened to find it. Finding-level labels (labels_*_v1.json) key on one run's clause wording and so undercount what a gate is protecting.
adjudicator: Opus, one reader, same standard across all three adjudications

sources: fact_shipped_contradicts_adjudicated.md, 'The 11 correct' (adds tet30 F6, tet47 F6, tet56 F29)

memo_match: a memo is named by its tetNN prefix; the corpus has one memo per prefix
